title: Winnie | Printed skirt with effortless drape
bodyHtml:
Feel feminine and free in this beautifully printed skirt that looks put-together the moment you slip it on. The relaxed cut lets you move, sit and walk without any tightness, while the fluid drape skims your shape with natural grace. It's the kind of piece that works just as well for a weekend walk around your neighbourhood as it does for lunch in town—versatile dressing at its best, paired with all-day comfort that actually lasts.

Why you'll love it

  • Printed design brings colour and personality to your everyday rotation
  • Fluid cut moves with you—no clinging, no restraint
  • Sits beautifully on your frame with a graceful, flattering drape
  • Elasticated waist adjusts to your body for effortless comfort from morning to evening
  • Practical pockets that are surprisingly deep and discreet
  • Skims without clinging—elegant movement that feels natural
  • Works for warm days and cooler evenings alike

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
